title: Recent errors (detail)
sqlTemplate: select _timestamp, session_id, error_type, error_source_type, error_message from _rumdata where service = {{service}} and env = {{environment}}{{version_clause}} and type = 'error' order by _timestamp desc limit 20
emptyDataSemantics: No matching error records -> an empty result set (zero rows). error_message/session_id are high-cardinality fields shown only as bounded (LIMIT 20, most-recent-first) list columns, never grouped/aggregated on.
